account: ITmedia's 岡田有花 reported on 22 Jun 2026 that Odakyu Electric Railway would introduce an “AI踏切画像解析システム” from 24 June 2026. It covers four crossings on its Odawara Line. They are Minami-Shinjuku Nos. 2, 4 and 5 between Minami-Shinjuku and Sangubashi stations, and Mukogaoka-Yuen No. 9 between Mukogaoka-Yuen and Ikuta stations. The AI analyzes footage from the existing safety-confirmation cameras in real time. It identifies and tracks pedestrians, wheelchair users, bicycles and motorcycles. When it detects someone left inside after the barriers come down, it sends a signal through the signaling equipment. That applies the brakes of approaching trains and lights the crossing's special signal lamps to alert crews. Both are released automatically once the crossing is clear. Images are used only for hazard detection, not to identify individuals, and analysis data are destroyed within a year. The system was developed by Meitetsu EI Engineer, Toyota Systems and Toho Electric Industries. It was trialed from January 2023, with work on detection accuracy at night and in rain. railf.jp carried the same announcement on 25 Jun 2026. No detection events or outcomes are reported.

fields.account: ITmedia's 岡田有花 reported on 22 Jun 2026 that Odakyu Electric Railway would introduce an “AI踏切画像解析システム” from 24 June 2026. It covers four crossings on its Odawara Line. They are Minami-Shinjuku Nos. 2, 4 and 5 between Minami-Shinjuku and Sangubashi stations, and Mukogaoka-Yuen No. 9 between Mukogaoka-Yuen and Ikuta stations. The AI analyzes footage from the existing safety-confirmation cameras in real time. It identifies and tracks pedestrians, wheelchair users, bicycles and motorcycles. When it detects someone left inside after the barriers come down, it sends a signal through the signaling equipment. That applies the brakes of approaching trains and lights the crossing's special signal lamps to alert crews. Both are released automatically once the crossing is clear. Images are used only for hazard detection, not to identify individuals, and analysis data are destroyed within a year. The system was developed by Meitetsu EI Engineer, Toyota Systems and Toho Electric Industries. It was trialed from January 2023, with work on detection accuracy at night and in rain. railf.jp carried the same announcement on 25 Jun 2026. No detection events or outcomes are reported.
